# Source: Zodiaque ("La Plume")

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Zodiaque ("La Plume")
- **Artist / culture:** Alphonse Marie Mucha Czech, 1860-1939
- **Date:** 1896–97
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** poster
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 111986
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/111986
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/119dba14-acf2-cdcd-e9e6-b9cd38bc3aad/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Public Poster

## Extracted source palette

`#C8A878, #987848, #784828, #C8B898, #C88828, #A89868, #E8E8D8, #786838`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#3E2515`
- `surface`: `#543E30`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#C88828`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#E8E8D8`
- `surface_variant`: `#543E30`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#726054`
- `error`: `#C88828`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `inter` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `2dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `13.34:1`, surface `9.37:1`
- Variant contrast: `9.37:1`
- Control contrast: `6.52:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
